test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I: **Some books are pens.

**Statement II:** All pens are pencils.

**Statement III:** No pencil is a marker.

**Conclusion I: **Some books are not pens.

**Conclusion II: **No pen is a marker.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given statements:

Some books are pens.

All pens are pencils.

No pencil is a marker.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/531644b334c922ff757ed7c2e84f730ac8048b9f18df789b48e95a9e47d7d767.png] 

Conclusion:

I: Some books are not pens. - **False **(Because, Some books are pens given, so some books are not pens it is not possible)

II: No pen is a marker. - **True **(Because, All pens are pencils and No pencil is a marker so No pen is a marker it is definite)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion II follows".**
